scope: Guided prediction/evidence diagram and matching report diagram

checks: Prediction diagrams: guide disclosure, keyboard range controls, exact scale changes, boundary and off-scale predictions, saved-state isolation, report preview and static exported diagram pass.

Report preview and real download preserve saved evidence and notes; keyboard open/close/Escape, other live setups, free exploration, long and hostile text, Unicode truncation, print control/media, invalidation and remount pass.

limits: Scoped tests, not the full repository suite.
